patch.title: Java4Shell patch (CVE-2026-114938)
patch.description: CVE-2026-114938 ("Java4Shell") is a memory corruption in OpenJDK's hardware-accelerated Base64 decoder (AVX-512 VBMI), affecting Java 17.0.6+, 21, 25 and 27 on x86-64. The launcher already applies the mitigation -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics to every launch. You can also install a patched Java 17 runtime and force its use.
